function.description: Preview a cross-chain bridge via Relay WITHOUT executing. Returns the route, the expected destination amount, fees, and the ETA. RETURNS `tokenMetadata` with `source`, `destination`, `amountRaw`, and nullable `amountHuman`; each EVM side is contract/registry verified or `kind: metadata_unavailable`, which blocks signing. Resolve fromToken and toToken separately with TokenFind on their exact chains. For an EVM token, call TokenFind with exactly one target chain and continue only when mutationReady is true. Ambiguous, provider-capped, or metadata-unreadable results are not executable identities. If the swap pair is already known, prefer its exact base or quote token address and use TokenFind to validate that address on the target chain. TokenFind reads symbol and decimals from the contract, never provider list metadata. Read decimals from a contract-verified TokenFind candidate on the exact source chain. A provider-list decimal is not signing authority, and a raw amount without contract decimals is unsafe. `amountRaw` is in RAW base units (wei/lamports). Call this BEFORE BridgeExecuteRelay: an execute is authorized only by a fresh matching quote on the SAME venue, so a Khalani quote cannot authorize a Relay execute. Khalani is the primary bridge route - reach for Relay when Khalani does not cover the route (it is the only venue for Robinhood Chain) or its quote failed for a routing reason.
function.name: BridgeQuoteRelay

amountRaw.description: Amount in raw atomic units of fromToken (e.g. USDC has 6 decimals, so 1 USDC = "1000000"). Read decimals from a contract-verified TokenFind candidate on the exact source chain. A provider-list decimal is not signing authority, and a raw amount without contract decimals is unsafe.

fromToken.description: Source token address, or native ETH/native.

recipient.description: Destination recipient override (defaults to your dest-chain wallet).

slippageBps.description: Slippage tolerance in basis points for the destination-side fill (1 bps = 0.01%). Higher tolerance widens the worst-case received amount on the destination chain. When a bridge quote fails or fills keep expiring, re-quote with a higher value rather than retrying the same one. Vex caps it at 1000 (10%) and rejects anything above rather than clamping.

toToken.description: Destination token address, or native ETH/native.
